title: Concept: Credential stored in user defaults (swift)
description: In swift, UserDefaults.standard.set writes into a plist that backups and forensic images expose. A refresh token kept there survives every lock screen and is readable without the passcode.
applicability: iOS apps that persist session or account values; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Session and credential disclosure from a backup or an extracted image; MEDIUM severity.
